ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixel distribution across approximately 85% of the visible ventral surface, with high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels concentrated in mottled clusters around the median notch and lower fluke boundary.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous dark masses cover the distal and upper portions of both lobes. A high-contrast light-colored mottled region is localized at the central confluence of the lobes. Distinct dark circular spots are mapped on the mid-interior region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central depression with a narrow convergence point relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and stochastic trailing edge boundary characterized by high-frequency, varying-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) across both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex mathematical curve fitted to the outer edges of both lobes, sweeping sharply upwards towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast, irregular pixel formations (scarring) localized at both distal tips; distinct dark circular clusters present on the right lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple near-vertical parallel linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the mid-right lobe, and sparse horizontal linear marks on the mid-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular structural erosion and scarring at both distal tips; prominent vertical rake marks on the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A pair of prominent, dark circular pixel anomalies located on the lower-medial section of the right lobe.
